findings.highlight: Her heart's been drumming a warning signal for some time from within the confines of her chest.
findings.evidenceJa: 胸の上から押さえつけた心臓は、ずいぶん前から慌ただしく危険信号を送っている。
findings.governingReading: Heart is pressed from above chest while beating warning, before later wall-supported walking; exact hand/agent not independently specified.
findings.explanation: Pressing heart through chest disappears into chest's confinement.

findings.highlight: She can't stop, even if she and the old man who turned her into a Master end up killing each other.
findings.evidenceJa: 自分をマスターにしたあの老人を、刺し違えてでも止めなくてはいけない。
findings.governingReading: She must stop the old man who made her Master even at cost of mutual destruction.
findings.explanation: Must stop old man becomes Sakura cannot stop.

findings.governingReading: Despite grandfather surely knowing she is here, he doesn't appear; next of course he is aware confirms omitted subject.
findings.explanation: He should know becomes I know.
